skins.name: Habitat
skins.description: Silence's dress for public events. She's been busy of late, and drifts to sleep in front of the camera. Luckily, she has Ifrit 's handmade alarm clock to help her stay awake.

skins.name: Born as One
skins.code: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Born as One
skins.description: An engraving leaves a shadow, like two sides of a coin, or the cycle of day and night. When both are aware of their dual nature, Laurentina possesses a soul most complete, like unto the twin moons.

skins.name: Golden Dream
skins.description: Lumen's casual leisure wear, tailored for elegance from lightweight materials. The sea mist has lifted, and you can now see the lighthouse without binoculars.

skins.name: Eine Variation
skins.description: A traditional-style gown worn by every Graf Urtica, now draped over Ebenholz's shoulders. Orders apathetically seep from the tip of the staff, piercing through the sparse ensemble of nobles.

skins.name: Remnant
skins.description: Originium has taken over the land, and what she envisioned has become a reality. She has enumerated and entrusted everything else to the others, leaving only her name as she hones her mission into a sharp blade.

skins.name: Ten Thousand Mountains
skins.code: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Ten Thousand Mountains
skins.description: Ch'en Hui-chieh entered the capital on a starry night, and left before sunrise after settling matters. She bid farewell to old friends and took a sampan down the river, the lamp on the prow crashing through the fog and night.

skins.name: Twines of Time
skins.code: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Twines of Time
skins.description: Orchid finally completed her design after several torturous nights. She stroked the delicate stitches on it, quietly praying for life.

skins.name: Granter of Colors
skins.description: Roberta's work outfit. With the other operators' help and encouragement, Roberta finally found the time to design a look for herself as well.

skins.name: Voyage of Feathers
skins.description: Placed in charge of the props, she sets them in place, as a flock of fowlbeasts circles higher into the sky, ships sailing into the distant horizon.
